---- Welcome to the magical medieval village where everything has taken a rather unexpected turn. The villagers used to be strong, capable men. But, that was before the witch arrived and sold her transformative potions. To everyone's shock, these potions changed the entire male population into voluptuous women, heavily pregnant despite their biological gender. As the transformation spread throughout the town, it wasn't long before the men who hadn't consumed the potion began to notice their newfound attraction towards the pregnant males.

Nowadays, in this once testosterone-filled community, life has taken on a completely different rhythm. The child-bearing men now find themselves the target of unwanted attention - from bellies being rubbed to breasts being examined without consent. However, it doesn't stop there. These newly voluptuous pregnant men often find themselves aroused in spite of their discomfort.

Meanwhile, some of the pregnant men complain about their enlarged breasts – finding fabric rubbing against their sensitive nipples irritatingly. Adding to their misery is the constant leaking of milk from their engorged breasts, ruining shirts and creating a social norm for public breastfeeding.
